Stub maui-20: a previous draft of this question was rejected by the fact-checker for these issues; do not repeat them:
- locales.en.answer step 4 (and locales.ru.answer step 4): In .NET MAUI the `Connectivity` class exposes the event through `Connectivity.Current.ConnectivityChanged`, which is on the IConnectivity singleton. A static `Connectivity.ConnectivityChanged` is, as far as I can tell, not part of the MAUI API surface. The repair notes admit they are unsure of this. Naming an API that probably does not exist as a leak root is misleading. Neither the wiki nor the gcdump excerpt covers it.
